events.verdict: Butler III (GSW) moves alongside Thomas' (BKN) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Santos (GSW) avoids making contact with the ball while it is in its flight toward the basket and has a chance to score.
Claxton (BKN) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Green's (GSW) possession. Any ensuing contact is considered incidental.
Claxton (BKN) retreats away from the pick and creates space for Santos (GSW) to avoid the contact.
Butler III (GSW) and Claxton (BKN) come together and make incidental hand to hand contact during the rebound before Butler's hand slides off the ball and makes marginal contact with Claxton's arm.
Payton II (GSW) brushes Claxton's (BKN) arm and marginal contact occurs during Claxton's shot attempt near the rim.
Green (GSW) moves around Claxton (BKN) and the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Russell (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Payton II (GSW) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the drive.
Russell (BKN) cleanly blocks Butler III's (GSW) driving shot attempt.
Johnson (BKN) is the last to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Butler III (GSW) and Johnson come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact that occurs as they meet is incidental.
Claxton (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Butler III (GSW) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the steal attempt.
Santos (GSW) grazes Johnson's (BKN) side during his driving shot attempt and the marginal contact does not affect his SQBR.
Claxton (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Curry (GSW) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the drive.
Claxton (BKN) dislodges the ball from Curry (GSW) and is the last to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
The ball is legally thrown into the backcourt after being advanced and there is no 8 second violation on the play. Therefore, it is deemed an inadvertent whistle.

Curry's (GSW) left foot goes into the backcourt while he is still in possession of the ball.
Claxton (BKN) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Curry (GSW) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Johnson's (BKN) layup attempt.
